remarks: Completely renovated and move-in ready, this stylish two-level townhouse offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and value in Norwalk's desirable Spring Hill neighborhood. Featuring 2 bedrooms and 1 beautifully updated bath, the home has been thoughtfully upgraded throughout with a brand-new kitchen, new appliances, sleek countertops, and a tiled backsplash designed for modern living. Newly refinished hardwood floors and custom window treatments add warmth and character, while natural light fills the spacious layout across both levels. Enjoy the peaceful courtyard setting, heat and hot water included in common charges, onsite laundry just downstairs, one detached garage space, plus an additional assigned parking spot. Ideally located steps from Norwalk Hospital and minutes to the SoNo Collection, restaurants, Metro North, major highways, and easy access to NYC.
